name: Duarte — Story Skills / Presentation Training
what_it_is: Corporate presentation/storytelling training company (Nancy Duarte) with workshops on story structure and delivery.
notes: B2B-priced; frameworks (sparkline) well documented in books/talks.

name: MasterClass — Communication cluster (Robin Roberts, Chris Voss, LeVar Burton, George Stephanopoulos, Matthew McConaughey)
what_it_is: Celebrity-taught video classes on communication, negotiation (Voss), storytelling (Burton), authentic communication (Roberts).

name: Kindra Hall — Stories That Stick courses
what_it_is: Business-storytelling courses (Mastery, Deep Dive) from 'Stories That Stick' author with 8+ hrs video and workbook; 4-story framework.
notes: Business-angle storytelling; framework public via book.

name: Mindvalley — Speak & Inspire (Lisa Nichols)
what_it_is: 30-day quest format course on speaking/inspiring by Lisa Nichols on Mindvalley's daily-lesson platform.
notes: Daily micro-lesson + task 'quest' format is a strong product pattern.

name: Coursera — Introduction to Public Speaking (Univ. of Washington, Matt McGarrity)
what_it_is: Classic university MOOC on speech design and delivery with recorded-speech assignments and peer review.

name: Improve Your Social Skills (Daniel Wendler)
what_it_is: Step-by-step social skills guide/course by autistic psychologist (r/socialskills founder): conversation, body language, stories, anxiety.

name: Conversation Skills Core (Paul Sanders)
what_it_is: Email/web courses on conversation flow, small talk, and making friends for shy adults.
